notes.claim: Two gears keyed onto the same shaft must revolve at the same speed.
To find a compound reduction, work out the reduction of each stage and multiply them together.

sources.title: Mechanisms: Gears
sources.quote: As both gears are keyed onto shaft B, they must revolve at the same velocity.

sources.title: Advanced Gears | REV ION Build System | REV Robotics Documentation
sources.quote: To calculate the total reduction of a compound reduction, identify the reduction of each stage and then multiply each reduction together.
